name: webmius-deploy
description: Build-time only package: exists so Heroku's Node.js buildpack can compile frontend/ into frontend/dist during slug compilation (see .buildpacks). Not used for local development - work inside frontend/ directly.

scripts.heroku-postbuild: export NODE_ENV=development && cd frontend && npx --yes pnpm@9.15.9 install --frozen-lockfile && VITE_API_URL='' npx --yes pnpm@9.15.9 run build
